body:
This is the very short story of my first 2C-I experience. I had stayed awake all night working on a DMT extraction, and at about 7:00AM tried smoking this DMT extract and found that it didn't work, probably due to low yield. Disappointed at this, I decided to finally try some of the 2C-I that I had gotten a month earlier and had pretty much forgotten about.
At the time of dosing up, with 16 mg dissolved in juice, I was extremely sleepy and fatigued. This was a mistake. My first 2C-I experience was an unpleasant one, because of how very tired I was. As the trip came on, I found myself only wanting to sleep. One half of my mind was being pulled down into sleep, and the other half was evaporating into a very strange and tense trip mixed with hypnagogia. Overall the trip was a miserable one because of my poor timing. My later 2C-I experiments, however, have proven to be fantastically amazing and in my opinion comparable to mescaline; 2C-I has become one of my very favorite drugs. I post this small trip report simply to caution everyone not to take 2C-I when you really want to sleep.
